spring.description: A clean water source. Used for Mara's remedy.

village_well.description: The contaminated well at the heart of the starting village.

mine_entrance.description: The sealed entrance to the old moonstone mine.

notice_board.description: A board where villagers post news and requests.

altar.description: An ancient altar. Its purpose is unknown.

campfire.description: A smouldering campfire. Someone was here recently.

crate.description: A sturdy wooden crate. Might contain supplies.

dungeon_entrance.description: A stone archway leading into an underground dungeon.

maze_entrance.description: A glowing mystical portal leading into a labyrinthine maze.

rune_black.description: An ancient rune carved in dark stone. Its meaning is lost to time.

rune_grey.description: A weathered rune, worn smooth by centuries. Someone carved this to last.

rune_blue.description: An Aetherian glyph, still faintly luminescent. This was important.
